## JustMic 1.3.0

- Guided updates: check for new versions at every launch, with a popup when the app is open or a Windows notification when it starts in the tray.
- A new update badge beside the app name and a redesigned Settings > Updates page show fetching, download and verification progress.
- See the published features and fixes from the versions you missed. Skip one version with a clear warning, then get reminders again for later releases; skipped versions remain installable in Settings.
- Update directly in the app: the official installer is checked against the release size and SHA-256 before Windows runs it. You approve installation; cancellation leaves JustMic running.
- Updates preserve settings, presets, sounds and startup preferences, avoid repeating driver setup, and restart JustMic after installation. Finish calls and close sound editors before updating.

Private monitoring, recording checks and portable backups from 1.2 remain available. Software headphone monitoring can be captured by other apps when privacy protection is disabled; use hardware monitoring for private listening.
